caption: Figure 5: GRACE’s reversible randomized packetization. The tensor elements mapped to a lost packet will be set to zeros.
subject: how GRACE's reversible random packetization maps tensor elements to packets so a lost packet only zeroes its mapped elements

groups.why_chosen: Mirrors one numbered, colour-grouped grid tensor on both sender and receiver sides, so a single simulated packet loss traces cleanly to exactly which grid cells go blank.
groups.what_to_learn: Number and colour-group the same grid tensor identically on both sides (sub-tensor = colour = packet); mark one packet lost with a red X, then blank only the grid cells that packet owned in the reconstructed tensor.
